title: malus × purpurea var. aldenhamensis
intro: Malus × purpurea var. aldenhamensis, commonly known as Aldenham crab apple, is a cultivar of the crab apple tree. This plant is believed to have potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Malus × purpurea var. aldenhamensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenolic compounds, including anthocyanins and quercetin, which are responsible for its potential health benefits.
